data.body: Evidence detail: sandboxed logs are .rebar/scratch/05f74084-win/verify-willet.log and .rebar/worktrees/{bug-create-replay,fix-janitor-byte-race,fix-ref-lock-test-bound,fix-test-git-maint-detach}/.rebar/scratch/s05f74084/make-verify.log; their pip output shows the sandbox proxy's 'Tunnel connection failed: 403 not in this command's allowed_domains'. The A/B logs are .rebar/scratch/s05f74084-f2/ab-sandboxed.log and ab-unsandboxed.log in worktree f2-verify-parity. Unsandboxed complete runs (temp dirs under /var/folders) failed only the then-red test_resign_makes_enforced_verify_pass_with_era_keys (fixed by 2825b4fe283) and once the review-bot 3 s marker (stinky-blushing-gelding). Probe timings outside the sandbox: python -m build --sdist of a minimal hatchling project 2.2 s; semgrep --validate of a one-rule config 1.7 s. Inside: build fails in 8.7 s (deny network-outbound pypi.org:443); semgrep --validate fails after 97 s (deny network-outbound semgrep.dev:443, /c/p/semgrep-rule-lints).
